provenanceModel: Evidence output and Release build are keyed by evidenceHead. Production source is pinned to candidateProductCommit (default ee08ee7), whose parent is baseline (default fbf93c1). Candidate-to-evidence changes are restricted to the three allowlisted evidence files.

runtimeSignals.metrics: N/A: pure synchronous Processing/Imaging comparison adds no production metric boundary.
runtimeSignals.logs: N/A: the host-neutral renderers do not log.
runtimeSignals.traces: N/A: no host worker or distributed operation is exercised.
runtimeSignals.health: N/A: no hosted service or dependency health boundary is exercised.

limitations: CPU and endpoint RSS are process-wide and can include test-host/runtime activity.
Retained LOH is measured at forced-GC path-group endpoints and is not per-operation attribution.

Both paths execute from the Release output built at evidenceHead; production source is pinned to candidateProductCommit and later commits are restricted to the allowlisted evidence files. Baseline ancestry and unchanged blob proofs are source-equivalence evidence, not a separately measured baseline build.
The deterministic synthetic Mono8 workload complements but does not replace unavailable external canonical W6 evidence.
Filesystem, SQLite, network, and backlog are N/A because both compared paths are synchronous in-memory operations.
Material greater-than-10-percent changes are flagged for disposition, not used as arbitrary fail thresholds.
